description: This file is an HTML webpage used as a client-side interface for visualizing databases, tables, and data. It includes HTML structure, CSS styles for layout and design, and JavaScript code handling interactions such as database selection, table loading, and data rendering.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of available databases from the server and displays them in the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the database list, resets the view, and initiates loading again.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses a database's table list and loads tables when expanded.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays the list of tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and visualizes data from a selected table, limited to 50 records.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Generates HTML for a data table with sortable columns and expandable cell contents.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Creates a table cell, handling nulls, objects, and long text with expandable features.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses table cell content to show full text or object data.
